Create an original interactive low-poly 3D scene called Signal Garden in this empty project. Write main.lua yourself. Use the native software mesh renderer with a small floor and several colorful geometric objects, a dark background, and a readable English HUD. The camera must move using Left/Right/Up/Down; A must change a visible object or palette. Keep meshes small and avoid rendering huge triangles repeatedly. This is CPU framebuffer rendering, not hardware-accelerated 3D. ds.camera3d(x,y,z,yaw,pitch) and ds.draw_mesh(mesh,x,y,z,yaw) use radians; positive Z is forward and Y is up. Expose inspect() with camera position, mode, and frames. Keep source below 8 KiB and complete within 20 tool calls.

Use a fixed-seed start_test and step_frames to assert movement and A-button interaction. Capture a representative frame with capture_screen, inspect the returned image on the next model turn, and fix visual defects. The host harness uses the real runtime and console font. Create a working checkpoint, finish_test, and leave the scene running. End with a concise report of actual checks. Do not claim DSi hardware acceleration or hardware frame rates.
